arithmetic.canonical_nan_output: When the destination format has a NaN encoding, every produced NaN is replaced by that format's canonical NaN encoding.
arithmetic.exception_model: IEEE-754 invalid, divide-by-zero, overflow, underflow, and inexact conditions are reported through the operation-defined architectural status; host traps are not observable.
arithmetic.fused_operations: A fused operation rounds once after the exact multiply-add expression.
arithmetic.signed_zero: IEEE signed zero is preserved by formats that encode both signs of zero; HiF8 has one zero encoding. Exact cancellation follows the selected rounding mode. Equal-sign zero inputs preserve that sign; a mixed-sign zero tie uses -0 for minimum and +0 for maximum.
arithmetic.standard: IEEE 754-2019 operation semantics with the explicitly enumerated low-precision format refinements
arithmetic.subnormals: supported by each format that defines subnormal encodings; flush-to-zero and denormals-are-zero are non-conforming for those formats

subnormal_policy.configuration_validation: Any request for FTZ, DAZ, or an operation-local subnormal override is non-conforming and must reject before effects.
subnormal_policy.result_subnormals: gradual underflow to the destination format
subnormal_policy.scope: Every otherwise-supported operation/type tuple whose source or destination format defines subnormal encodings.

canonicalize.0: Do not pre-canonicalize source NaN payloads; every produced NaN in a NaN-capable destination is still canonical.
canonicalize.1: Replace every NaN source by its source-format canonical NaN before the operation; signed zero is unchanged.

rounding_modes.0: NONE: use the operation-defined default; the hardware numeric default is RNE
rounding_modes.5: RNA: nearest, ties away from zero
rounding_modes.6: RTO: round to odd when inexact
rounding_modes.7: RHB: nearest, with an exact halfway result selecting the numerically greater candidate toward positive infinity

saturation.disabled: Integer arithmetic wraps to destination width; floating overflow follows the destination format; invalid float-to-integer conversion returns the exact destination indefinite value in conversion.float_to_integer_invalid.
saturation.enabled: Integer arithmetic and conversion clamp to destination minimum/maximum; NaN converts to zero; floating overflow clamps to the destination maximum finite value.

comparisons.signed_zero: +0 and -0 compare equal and neither is less than the other for formats with signed zero

float_to_integer_invalid.packed_rule: Each logical lane is converted independently; an invalid lane receives the lane-width indefinite value without changing another lane.
float_to_integer_invalid.signed_rule: The indefinite value is the minimum signed value of the destination lane.
float_to_integer_invalid.unsigned_rule: The indefinite value is the maximum unsigned value of the destination lane.

rhb.definition: Round to the nearest representable value; if the source is exactly halfway between two candidates, select the numerically greater candidate.

data_types.format: e8m10 in a 32-bit carrier; discarded fraction bits are zero
data_types.name: TF32

data_types.format: e8m11 in a 32-bit carrier; discarded fraction bits are zero
data_types.name: HF32

encoding.exponent: For D>0 Em contains exponent sign Se followed by D-1 stored magnitude bits; prepend an implicit magnitude bit 1. Se=0 is positive and Se=1 is negative. D=0 means E=0.
encoding.layout: sign S in bit 7, then a variable-length dot prefix, D exponent bits, and the remaining mantissa bits

data_types.format: OCP MX FP6 E3M2 in a zero-extended 8-bit carrier
data_types.name: E3M2

data_types.format: OCP MX FP6 E2M3 in a zero-extended 8-bit carrier
data_types.name: E2M3

data_types.format: two OCP MX FP4 E2M1 logical lanes
data_types.name: E2M1X2

data_types.format: two public HiF4 E1M2 logical lanes; a distinct DataType identity used by MX
data_types.name: HiF4X2

claim_requires: the exact profile ID and release content hash
all generated hardware numeric boundary vectors
independent downstream byte and effect parity

matrix.destination_model: Every active CUBE operation writes explicit Local D. Base, BIAS, and MX variants initialize the dot product from zero; .ACC variants initialize it from explicit Local C.
matrix.destination_aliasing: D == C is read-old/write-new and requires identical dtype, shape, layout, and allocation. There is no architectural implicit ACC singleton and ACCCVT remains removed/reserved.
matrix.bias_order: BIAS is added in logical result type after the complete dot product; MX BIAS is FP32 and is added after the scaled dot product.
matrix.dot_order: Products are accumulated in increasing logical K index order with one fused multiply-add rounding to the declared physical ACC type per term.

mx.scale_order: Decode both E8M0 scales and multiply each corresponding logical input by its scale before the fused multiply-add. A 0xFF scale makes the FP32 term and resulting ACC lane canonical NaN.

min_max.both_nan: canonical destination NaN when the destination format has NaN

packed_storage.dimensions: Tile rows, columns, valid rows, valid columns, matrix M/N/K, and scale-block K count are logical-lane dimensions, not byte-carrier dimensions.
packed_storage.lane_order: Logical lane 2*i is bits 3:0 of storage byte i; logical lane 2*i+1 is bits 7:4 of storage byte i.
packed_storage.partial_final_byte: When a logical extent is odd, the unused high nibble of the final storage byte is reserved and MUST be zero on publication. Consumers ignore it.

reductions.evaluation_order: increasing logical row-major index; no reassociation
reductions.max_min_nan: ignore a NaN when a numeric operand exists; all-NaN input returns canonical NaN
reductions.rounding: round to the declared accumulator type after each step

reference_model_relation.rule: pto-v0 output values are not hardware numeric conformance evidence

sort.nan_order: after all numeric values and stable by original index in both directions
sort.output: value paired with U32 original index
sort.signed_zero_order: +0 and -0 compare equal; original index controls their stable order
